slice: participant P01 session and presentation repair
directive_source: plan-scoped next-task directive after the CLEAN 19.97 review on c789821836f0bea77b52666a405c3830d010a87d

participant.recruitment: Caller explicitly selected one actual participant; not a representative sample.
reported_issues: English and unfamiliar terminology were the primary comprehension obstacle.
Control meanings were unclear; hover explanations were suggested.
No artifact was visible in the centre, so the judgement target was unidentified.
The right pane could not be scrolled and its content overlapped the lower pane.
The top pane occupied too much space.
participant.treatment: Recorded as observations and not rewritten after the repair; no post-repair participant result exists.

repair.scope: Presentation only: ui-model display text/labels, desktop-gpui shell/inspector/intervention/palette/stop/dock/flow, app-core surface labels, plus the help module. No new dependency, public protocol type, unsafe/FFI, Runtime semantic, media implementation or persistence change.
changes: User-facing headings, axis labels, button names, surface names, notices and unavailable reasons use Japanese; closed protocol statuses carry a Japanese gloss plus the canonical token, while Runtime identities, free text, artifact/evidence summaries and unknown values stay verbatim.
Every explained control keeps its accessible name/description and gains a lazy hover explanation rendered only when hovered (help module).

The inspector is its own scroll container with hidden overflow, so expanded sections stay reachable and never overlap the Candidate Dock; the work surface contains its text instead of overflowing horizontally.
The header keeps the same six state axes but no longer repeats multi-line explanations, reducing its height; the Stop row states its own condition inline.
The Artifact surface states that the current version cannot display artifact images and that only candidate explanation text is shown; no placeholder image or simulated success is used.
Dock iteration gutters show the full 反復 N label and the group-start marker moved to the candidate label, so the iteration axis stays legible in a narrow card.
Withheld/unavailable publications discard the per-consumer derivation cache again, keeping the documented invalidation invariant.
Removed source-text tests only; the weakened evidence/refinement/dock assertions were restored as field-level and reason-level checks.
